task_message:
Case M04: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 230x230x165 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M04 is complete.

**Summary**
- **Target found:** a well-circumscribed, markedly T2-hyperintense ovoid mass in the anterior soft tissues (myxoid soft-tissue tumor).
- **Method:** initial positive points on two interior marks (v1, 46.5 mL), verified the outline against all three planes, then ran one refinement (v2, 45.7 mL) which tightened the boundary.
- **Checks:** reviewed axial slices every ~4 mm (44–112), plus sagittal (84–124) and coronal (145–192) with the mask overlay; the past-the-mask review panels showed no residual lesion at either end.
- **Candidates:** automatic intensity-only proposals (fascial/skin crescents and pole caps, 0.6–5.8 mL) were inspected; accepting them extended the mask into linear fascial/partial-volume signal (axial 41) that did not look tumoral, so they were rejected (accept → undo).
- **Final mask:** single component, 45.7 mL, extent axial 47–109, coronal 149–188, sagittal 84–122; saved with medium confidence (main residual uncertainty is the subjective boundary at the tapering poles).
